shape.name: eight-petal cosmos flower
shape.topology: A central flower disk surrounded by eight broad radial petals, without stem or leaves
shape.silhouette: A central flower disk surrounded by eight broad radial petals, without stem or leaves
shape.label: External Integrations

animation: fixed local positions; bounded brightness propagation only; no model-local rigid motion
label: External Integrations

motion.phaseMeaning: Core phase 0; each petal root 0 to tip 1. Petals are geometric parts, not service assignments.
rules: Animate brightness only. Local point positions are anchored; do not integrate positions, rigidly rotate, deform, emit, or resize the model.
Keep all structural points visible in idle, activity zero, disconnected and unlit portions. Keep pointCount, size, seed and weight fixed across states.
Use one health color across the entire shape; groups control brightness, never independent health colors or monitoring targets.
Use bounded modulo time. Maximum working speed is 1.3 times the reference, never driven by utilization.
Cap the combined wave, breathing and utilization brightness uplift at 10 percent. Separate observed static capacity/seat/load brightness from activity uplift.

Health overrides activity. Fault stops ordinary flow and permits at most idle-strength breathing; a newly identified observed event may flash softly once for about one second, never on repeated retrieval.
Disconnected and unknown stop all temporal brightness changes. Stale retains health color at 45 percent of normal brightness and stops breathing, flow and event flashes.
Reduced motion stops breathing, flow, event flashes and value interpolation; retain fixed coordinates, per-point steady brightness and current supplied color/labels.
The model does not infer health, fabricate activity or missing observations, change monitoring thresholds, or introduce measurement APIs. Missing inputs remain unknown rather than zero.
Scene placement and orbital transforms are separate from model-local animation. Reference timing is a production proposal, not a monitoring threshold.
motion.suggestion: Idle: weak core and petal breathing. Observed working input only: core-to-tip light. Explicit starting input fills roots outward. No petal motion or invented petal-to-service mapping.
motion.specificationStatus: production-proposal; monitoring rules and APIs are not implemented
